data.name: Sunset Splash Adventure
data.headline: All Ages • 5 pm to Sunset • Inside & Outside Seating
data.description: There is no better place to swim than Hawaii and no better way to watch the sunset than from the Waikiki Coastline. Experience an unforgettable time and be amazed at the natural island beauty as day turns to night and twilight blankets us with an array of amazing colors that you can only see in our special part of the world.
data.highlights:
- Spectacular Hawaii sunset from the water
- Sailing aboard a 55ft catamaran
- Family-friendly experience


**Book now and receive Complimentary Waikiki History Tour Cruise Adventure from Pink Sails!**
data.itinerary:
- Depart from the harbor: Sail along the Waikiki coastline
- Sunset views: Watch the vibrant sunset colors over the Pacific Ocean
- Return to the harbor: Enjoy the evening breeze and onboard refreshments
data.what_is_included:
Scenic sunset sail
Tour in English
data.what_is_not_included:
Drinks (available for purchase onboard)
Snorkel gear (snorkeling not allowed for safety)
what_is_not_included_items: Snorkel gear (snorkeling not allowed for safety)

Camera
Towel
Sunscreen
Sweater or light jacket

what_to_bring_items: Cash or card for drinks, tips, or souvenirs
data.cancellation_summary: Full refund or credit with 24 hours' notice. No-shows charged full price.
data.cancellation_notes:
Changes, including rescheduling and cancellations, must be made at least **24 hours prior** to your scheduled tour time.

* Customers who provide at least **24 hours’ notice** will receive a **full refund or credit**.
* Customers will also receive a **full refund or credit** if the tour is canceled by the operator due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.
* **No-shows** will be charged **the full price**.

To cancel or inquire about a change, please **contact us by phone** at (808) 922-7722 (Option 2).

---

**Private Charters:**
Cancellations must be made at least **14 days prior** to the scheduled charter date to receive a full refund or credit.
data.check_in_details: Arrive 30 minutes prior to departure for check-in and waivers.
data.restrictions:
- Snorkelling is not allowed for safety
- No BYOB except on private charters with prior approval.
data.faqs:
- **Can I bring my own alcohol?** No, alcohol is available for purchase onboard. BYOB is only allowed on private charters with prior approval.
- **Where should I park?** Street parking is available for $1 per hour. Only park in white stalls; yellow stalls are permit-only.
